company.name: Redwood Materials
company.shortDescription: Redwood Materials is a battery recycling startup that makes electric vehicles and sustainable materials for circular supply chains.
company.description: Redwood Materials creates a circular supply chain to drive down the environmental footprint and cost of lithium-ion batteries and the electric vehicles and sustainable energy storage systems they power. It offers recycling of end-of-life batteries and production scrap, refining of critical elements, and deployment of large-scale energy-storage systems using second-life battery packs.

productsAndServices.description: Large-scale battery storage systems designed, integrated, and deployed for data centers, utilities, renewable projects, industrial facilities, and grid applications using new and repurposed batteries.
productsAndServices.name: Redwood Energy Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)

productsAndServices.description: Collection, processing, and recycling of end-of-life lithium-ion batteries, production scrap, battery packs, and consumer devices to recover reusable critical materials.
productsAndServices.name: Lithium-Ion Battery Recycling

productsAndServices.description: Refined lithium, nickel, cobalt, and copper recovered from used batteries and production scrap for use in domestic battery manufacturing and other industrial applications.
productsAndServices.name: Battery-Grade Critical Materials

productsAndServices.description: Battery cathode active material manufactured from refined and recycled feedstocks for use in lithium-ion battery cell production.
productsAndServices.name: Cathode Active Material

productsAndServices.description: Copper foil for lithium-ion battery anodes, manufactured as a domestic battery component using Redwood’s integrated materials-production capabilities.
productsAndServices.name: Anode Copper Foil

productsAndServices.description: A service for auto recyclers and dismantlers to identify, price, sell, and arrange pickup of electric-vehicle and hybrid battery packs through Redwood’s online portal.
productsAndServices.name: EV Battery Pack Buying and Collection Service

They are developing battery collection bins and sorting systems, as in 'Battery collection systems and methods of using the same' and 'Automated battery sorting system.'
